g.title: PWN_Feedback
g.text: pwn-ai - evidence-backed feedback, not automatic improvement

g.title: Loop
g.text: TaskSummarizer compass is UX, not acceptance

g.title: Host
g.text: HOST injects OS summary + PreflightChecker health

g.title: Prompt
g.text: budgeted memory / skills / lessons / mistakes / policy

g.title: Final
g.text: no tool calls != done; all original obligations apply

g.title: World
g.text: on-demand observe / intel / watch / verify / RF etc.
auto baseline: host / repo / env only

g.title: Evidence
g.text: executed authored checks; failed/unknown stay distinct

g.title: Policy
g.text: positive training credit requires independent action attribution

g.title: Regression
g.text: exact failure/request digest + operator-authored expected bytes
inert file/JSON recipe; split remains regression

g.title: Skill
g.text: auto-safe limited to proven additions to existing SOPs

g.title: Weights
g.text: not proof that a live adapter improved

g.title: Eval
g.text: public held-out tasks; no live LLM gain claim

g.title: Regression->Eval
g.text: regression replay only; never relabel held-out

g.title: Promote
g.text: Operator approval + stopped writers + explicit target
